content.value_statement: Search visibility depends on crawlability, metadata, page structure, and structured data. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code apply practical SEO checks and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Reviews crawlability basics, including robots.txt, meta robots tags, canonical URLs, and XML sitemaps.
Provides on-page SEO guidance for title tags, meta descriptions, headings, images, and internal links.
Supplies structured data patterns for organizations, articles, products, FAQs, and breadcrumbs.
Covers mobile SEO checks for viewport settings, tap targets, and readable font sizes.
Explains international SEO basics, including hreflang tags and language declarations.
Offers a prioritized SEO audit checklist for critical, high priority, medium priority, and ongoing work.
limitations: It does not perform live crawling, ranking analysis, or Search Console API checks by itself.
It offers only partial guidance for content quality and does not address backlinks or authority building.
It cannot guarantee ranking improvements because search engines use many external signals.
AI search visibility guidance is explicitly described as emerging and unproven.

use_cases.title: Improve a Marketing Page
use_cases.description: Review titles, descriptions, headings, image alt text, and internal links before publishing a campaign page.

use_cases.title: Add Structured Data
use_cases.description: Choose the right schema type and validate rich result markup for products, articles, FAQs, and breadcrumbs.

use_cases.title: Run a Technical SEO Review
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to prioritize crawlability, sitemap, canonical, mobile, and indexing fixes for a site audit.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one page before publishing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for SEO basics. Check the title, meta description, headings, image alt text, internal links, and mobile viewport. Return prioritized recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Structured Data Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Select schema types for a page template.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend structured data for this page type. Explain which schema types fit, what fields are required, and how to validate the result.

prompt_templates.title: Technical SEO Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Audit a site or application release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this site for technical SEO. Focus on robots.txt, sitemap coverage, canonical URLs, HTTPS, mobile readiness, hreflang, and crawlable internal links.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Search Visibility Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine classic SEO with AI search visibility checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this content for search and AI answer visibility. Assess structured data, first-paragraph clarity, crawl rules for AI bots, and risks from unproven optimization tactics.

output_examples.input: A product page has a generic title, missing meta description, weak headings, and no product schema.
output: Critical: Add a unique product title that includes the primary keyword and brand context.
High: Write a page-specific meta description that matches the product and includes a clear benefit.
Medium: Add product structured data and validate it with a rich results tool.

output_examples.input: A blog article should be optimized for organic search and AI summaries.
output: Use one descriptive H1 and organize supporting sections with clear H2 and H3 headings.
Make the first paragraph answer the main query directly in one or two sentences.
Add article structured data and keep author, publisher, and date fields accurate.

output_examples.input: A multilingual site has English, Spanish, and French versions of the same page.
output: Confirm each page declares the correct language and references alternates for every locale.
Include an x-default alternate for users without a matched language version.
Keep canonical URLs aligned with the correct localized page.

best_practices: Prioritize crawlability, indexing, canonical URLs, titles, and mobile readiness before lower impact enhancements.
Validate structured data with trusted tools before publishing changes to production.
Keep recommendations tied to the page purpose, search intent, and visible content.
anti_patterns: Do not promise ranking gains from metadata changes alone.
Do not add structured data that describes content or offers missing from the page.
Do not treat llms.txt or AI crawler settings as proven ranking signals.

faq.question: Does this skill run a live SEO crawler?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and checklists, but another tool must crawl the site or collect live metrics.

faq.question: Can it help with structured data?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes common schema patterns for organizations, articles, products, FAQs, and breadcrumbs.

faq.question: Does it cover mobile SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes checks for responsive viewport settings, tap target size, and readable font sizes.

faq.question: Does it improve backlinks?
faq.answer: No. Backlinks and domain authority are outside the documented scope of this skill.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it during implementation?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance can help agents update metadata, headings, links, structured data, and SEO checklists.

faq.question: Is the AI search advice guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that AI search visibility is unstable and that some tactics remain unproven.
